description: Transcribes an audio file (a public https URL or base64, up to 6 MB; WAV, MP3, M4A or OGG as the model accepts them) to text with a Cloudflare Workers AI Whisper model, returning the text and any timestamped segments the model gives. Requires the env.AI binding. Choose this tool for: Transcribes an audio file to text with a Cloudflare Workers. Close alternatives on this server: agent_intel_multilingual_voice_tts (Turns text into speech with a Cloudflare Workers AI TTS); agent_intel_dnssec_trust_chain_validator (DNSSEC status for a domain using Cloudflare's public). Price: $0.004 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
